- Visitor areas: lobbies, information desks, displays, benches, glass
- Storage and maintenance spaces: shops, supply closets, equipment rooms

- Kitchens/cafeterias (if present): general cleaning and drain considerations
- Floors: daily sweeping/mopping, slip-resistance, periodic deep cleaning
- Windows/glass: exterior and interior haze-free cleaning
- Waste management: trash, recycling, pest control
- Compliance and safety: spill response, PPE, eco-friendly products, environmental policies
- Frequency guidance: restrooms/high-touch surfaces daily; offices weekly; deep clean monthly
- Special considerations: avoid disrupting sensitive habitats; prevent chemical runoff
